visualCharacteristics.stylingNotes: Looks like a body paragraph: no quote mark graphic, border or portrait. The speaker's name and title are bold and sit inline in the quote text ('said Sarah Day, vice president, ...').
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Pull quote in body-text style with the attribution inline
visualCharacteristics.description: Plain quotation paragraph with an inline bold attribution

contentPattern.summary: A quotation outside an interactive component is a quote block; the inline attribution (said Sarah Day, ...) belongs to it. The preceding H2 stays default content.
contentPattern.structure: row 1, one cell: the quotation paragraph(s), which may already include the inline attribution with the speaker in bold. Row 2 (optional), one cell: a separate attribution; with inline-attribution it is appended to the end of the last quotation paragraph

usage.description: Executive quote in newsroom story bodies ('What our experts are saying').

reuseGuidance: Use for story quotes that read as body text. Use the base quote for a styled pull quote.
